cases.witness: After a request acquires transaction advisory lock, its booking repository lookup stalls indefinitely. SET LOCAL lock_timeout only limits acquisition wait, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=0 removes the idle transaction backstop, and the lock remains held while the stalled callback is unresolved; a second notice times out acquiring the workspace lock. The code has no upper bound or cooperative cancellation.
cases.expectedFix: Bound the entire transaction/handler lifetime, including stalled DB queries and outbound provider calls. Coordinate abort, transaction cleanup and no further sends after lock loss; do not merely change acquisition lock_timeout.

cases.witness: sendDepositReminder reads pending while holding workspace lock and waits on the transport; confirmDeposit reads and marks paid without acquiring that lock. Payment becomes paid before the outbound reminder is actually delivered; email still requests a paid deposit.
cases.expectedFix: Serialize the payment-state transition and reminder eligibility using one consistent workspace lock or durable atomic send-claim protocol across processes, while explicitly handling provider timeouts/retries.
